heading: A little about me
paragraphs: I'm Abhishek Thakur — a Web Designer focused on building modern, responsive and user-friendly websites.

With 1.6+ years of experience and 40+ live client websites, I've worked across WordPress, Elementor, Beaver Builder, Framer, Squarespace, Wix and more, delivering websites for clients across the US, UK, Australia and Canada.
Beyond design, I also work with React, JavaScript and Tailwind CSS, which helps me understand both the visual and technical side of the web.
